_meta.experiment: M2 E5 slide and slide-jump momentum
_meta.truth: client MOVE-TRACE first-time usercmds; dt per usercmd = FrameTime() of the joined HSD client frame
_meta.evidence_levels: A = observed exactly (spread ~0) in every trial; B = fitted, spread <= 5 %; C = consistent but only one operating point or bracketed; D = census value, not exercised

slideRequiredStartSpeed.formula: slide starts on the duck-press usercmd when grounded and |v_xy| >= value (threshold not exercised: slide entries were at 299, 248 and 350 u/s)

slideSpeedBoost.source: census slideSpeedBoost; data only bound it: slideSpeedBoost*msc >= 161 (unscaled 150 rejected)
slideSpeedBoost.formula: v_peak = min(v_entry + slideSpeedBoost*msc, slideSpeedBoostCap*msc); lastSlideBoost = v_peak - v_entry

slideSpeedBoostCap.evidence: A for 460 at msc 1.15 from 299; C for the scaling (one movescale)

slideDecel.source: census slideDecel (unscaled), confirmed: free fit a = D + k*v per trial over all slide usercmds

slideVelocityDecay.unit: fraction of speed kept per second
slideVelocityDecay.source: census slideVelocityDecay, confirmed: free fit exp(-k) per trial

slideStopSpeed.source: census slideStopSpeed; last slide usercmd has pre >= 125 and post < 125
slideStopSpeed.formula: slide ends after the first usercmd whose post speed < slideStopSpeed (unscaled)

slideDuration_from460.formula: continuous: t = ln((v0 + D/k) / (125 + D/k)) / k = 1.689 s for v0 = 460; the census law stepped on the observed dt ends on the same usercmd (244) in 5/5 trials

crouchOverspeedDecel.source: fitted, rounded; no census key identified (standing decel = deceleration 1250; ratio 1.2)
crouchOverspeedDecel.formula: ducked, after the slide: v' = max(v - 1500*dt, 92)

crouchMaxSpeed.source: observed MT maxspeed (ms=92) and steady speed

standStopDecel.source: fitted on e1_sprint release (baseline) == census deceleration

slideBoostRefundWindow.source: Phase 1 source note (player.h m_lastSlideBoost); data bracket 0.201 < w <= 0.597
slideBoostRefundWindow.formula: slide jump with t_since_boost < window: v_h' = v_h - lastSlideBoost

slideBoostRefundAmount.source: observed take-off speed change of the early jump (contains about +0.008 u/s air accel)
slideBoostRefundAmount.formula: refund = lastSlideBoost (161 here: the actual gain, not slideSpeedBoost)

slideMaxJumpSpeed.source: census slideMaxJumpSpeed; observed late take-off speed (unscaled)
slideMaxJumpSpeed.formula: chosen: outside the refund window v_h' = max(v_h, 350); alternative max(v_h, min(v_h + J, 350)) with J >= 31.85 u/s cannot be separated by these data

slideJumpHeight.source: census slideJumpHeight; H estimated from the jump usercmd's post vz
slideJumpHeight.formula: v_up = sqrt(2*750*slideJumpHeight) = 273.86 u/s; the logged post vz of the jump usercmd = v_up - 1.5*g*dt

gravity.source: fitted (median of -dvz/dt per airborne usercmd, per trial)

landingWhileDucked.formula: landing with duck held and v >= 200: slide resumes on the landing usercmd, no speed loss, no new boost
